status: fixed before new fits; bounded development on previously inspected caches

folds.reuse: same image assignment as preceding audit; no split search

baseline.interaction: one centered/scaled product of train-standardized logit_mc and margin, additive candidate only
baseline.duplicate_basis: remove equal or sign-equivalent standardized columns

support.definition: N_k is the existing D_sup independent-image count for prototype k; h_k=log1p(N_k)/log1p(1191)
support.causal_scope: counts are class-associated; no causal identification of sample size versus class difficulty

correction.offset: fixed MM_additive fitted on the same training images
correction.form: centered/scaled linear inputs plus penalized intercept
correction.selection: inner image-OOF all-pixel IPW NLL; earlier candidate wins improvements <=1e-5

permutation.mapping: per-pixel identity-keyed random bijection of non-a (similarity,prototype image-count) tuples; classifier logits and a tuple unchanged
permutation.refit: all G/S/T candidates independently refit with identical folds, optimizer, fallback and selection; five separate T_sham results
permutation.frozen_intervention: apply selected real T model to each shuffled feature set; descriptive dependence check only
permutation.interpretation: five fixed negative controls, not a calibrated permutation-test p-value or independent teacher seeds
permutation.tie_rule: h_c follows the real-cache argmax winning tuple under exact prototype ties

tables: MC x margin x c support band
prototype class support and conflict outcomes
strata.boundary_usage: cached GT boundary is descriptive only and never a scorer input

statistics.primary_estimator: equal mean of three within-outer-fold metrics
statistics.secondary_estimator: pooled OOF, explicitly not a gate
statistics.bootstrap_unit: resample full images within each outer fold; pair all methods and stages; aggregate fold metrics
statistics.sham_aggregation: mean of five separately refitted method metrics, never rank averaged sham scores
statistics.limitations: intervals condition on saved fits and fixed folds; no training-population or unseen-data inference

gate.workpoints: late fold-mean conflict P@90 and C@95 of T >= MM
gate.support: all three late conflict folds meet fold minimum
gate.pass: eligible to propose one fixed repaired-BN confirmation; this run never trains a teacher
gate.fail: stop this fixed support-conditioned anchor scorer; no extra knots, seeds, formulas, datasets, teachers or hyperparameter search
gate.inadequate_support: inconclusive and stop expansion; do not select favorable classes

validation_usage: already inspected development description only; read only after all stage fits and selections are frozen; never tune or gate

order: D_rel statistics, permutation and support diagnosis
execution.publish: code, plan, aggregate records and hashes; no images, logits, features, checkpoints or keys
